summary: The maintained image helper owns a closed sc2-headless profile through one internal module, sharing command capture, journal and OCI validation rather than a separate launcher. Exact helper/product/source/support/configuration objects and externally selected private product pins are hash-bound before effects; selected correspondence is not operation authority. One original boot/monotonic work interval plus retirement aperture applies across commands, hash scans, sampling and cleanup without phase renewal. Combined raw output and retained metadata are bounded across the operation. Direct-child kernel birth, namespace observation, stream EOF and wait are independent facts: short-child namespace loss is retained as an observation gap, and leader exit does not prove pipe or descendant settlement. Only retained direct birth permits signalling; native censuses do not authorize foreign removal. Shared-host reservations and independent enclosing-cgroup headroom are separately admitted, while sampled affinity/RSS/disk policies do not establish hard containment. Disk population includes allocation context/build/export/evidence and the disjoint load store once. Streaming OCI validation bounds headers, extensions, expanded bytes and virtual path memory, discards tar member caches, and checks regular source evidence before verified same-object load. The SC2-only FIFO exception is exact zero-content CLR debug metadata; it never opens or extracts a FIFO, and aliases, FIFO hardlink targets and nonregular required evidence refuse. Other profiles retain their type policy. Actual-caller synthetic controls cover the shared capture, original lifetime, resource refusals, source substitutions, native dependency gates, OCI replacements and first-cause cleanup. Source controls do not qualify current engines, namespaces, image fit, product behavior, whole-descendant cleanup or worker-loss containment. Native operation remains separately admitted and qualified; restricted product/evidence identities stay outside public source and records. Review found that fsync of journal contents alone did not publish the newly created operation and journal directory entries. The controller now syncs the state-parent entry, empty journal and operation-directory entry before its first launch intent; each intent is synced before Popen. Injected sync failures stop before child launch and retain the consumed directory. Ordered source controls do not establish physical power-loss recovery. Internal profile import suppresses bytecode caching so loading the implementation cannot itself dirty the selected helper checkout before its source checks. A follow-up source-closure check found that disabling bytecode writes alone still allowed a timestamp-valid cached module to execute before cleanliness checks. The maintained loader now compiles bounded regular source bytes directly, bypassing cache reads as well as writes, and binds the captured digest to the externally selected module hash before dispatch. An actual isolated CLI control supplies cache code first proven usable by Python’s ordinary loader and verifies that the maintained path executes source instead; malformed or substituted selection still refuses before launch. The first required hosted aggregate stopped before engine preflight because Python 3.12 raised PermissionError while probing known forbidden global storage paths before the intended policy refusal. Shared storage preflight now rejects lexical global-store scope before filesystem observation and retains all later symlink, resolved-alias, source and disjointness guards. Actual-caller controls inject inaccessible-path observation and require refusal without calling it. Original failed qualification remains failed; local controls do not transfer to a repaired hosted head. Workflow byte changes also require exact current execution-pin registration even when Action references and permissions are unchanged. The repaired image/executor source qualifications passed, but general architecture tests correctly stopped on stale registration hashes before their intended updater-negative assertions; recovery and evidence aggregation then could not complete. The source correction refreshes exactly the two changed workflow hashes, preserving every reference and the existing strict validator and assertions. A complete tracked-workflow/baseline/current-document hash and reference census complements, and does not replace, actual hosted validator qualification. Passed source/profile regression does not convert the failed general qualification or establish SC2 native readiness.
title: Keep the closed SC2 image operation inside the maintained image controller
